claude.rationale: The slice documents only financial/corporate events within the window — a $650M technology/IP divestiture to RingCentral and a 2022 lender-consented uptier debt amendment that subordinated non-consenting lenders and drew litigation — but no evidence of product/process misalignment (p4) or operations-vs-organization/culture fracture (p5). Because the entity deregistered in December 2018, no audited financial or operational-integration record exists for the ~2021-2023 window, so neither interface pathway can be affirmatively determined. Per the conservative convention, the documented lender dispute is a financing/creditor matter, not documented product/process or process/organization disruption, and the absence of visibility into integration dynamics makes both pathways uncertain rather than 0.
